[Labyrinthine Echoes](/Feats.aspx?ID=5371) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />

You can make your voice reverberate off any surface. Once per day, you can cast [_ventriloquism_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1740) as an occult innate spell. At 7th level, this spell is heightened to 2nd rank.
